name: Recreational boating accidents by state and year: incidents, deaths, injuries and damage (U.S. Coast Guard), 2019 to 2024
description: Recreational boating incidents reported to the U.S. Coast Guard, for the nation and for each state, DC and territory in each year from 2019 to 2024: incidents, fatal incidents, incidents with a non-fatal injury, property-damage-only incidents, deaths, people injured and property damage in dollars. The Coast Guard called these accidents until its 2024 report and now calls them incidents. Incidents offshore (Atlantic, Pacific, Gulf) are in the national record only. Each year comes from that year's Coast Guard report.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Recreational boating accidents by state and year: incidents, deaths, injuries and damage (U.S. Coast Guard), 2019 to 2024 (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23962985

distribution.name: boating-accidents.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: boating-accidents.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: boating-accidents-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in boating-accidents-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to boating-accidents.csv on id.

recordSet.name: boating-accidents
recordSet.description: The records of Recreational boating accidents by state and year: incidents, deaths, injuries and damage (U.S. Coast Guard), 2019 to 2024, one per CSV row.

field.name: incidents

field.name: injury_incidents
field.description: Incidents with a non-fatal injury and no death

field.name: property_damage_incidents
field.description: Incidents with property damage only

field.name: deaths

field.name: injured
field.description: People injured

field.description: Property damage in dollars (rounded)

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "
